headline: Tsipras: We have a series of very scandalous tax exemptions on large wealth – We will ensure private universities are non-profit
summary: Former Greek prime minister Alexis Tsipras cited Eurostat data showing VAT revenue rose by 8 billion and income tax revenue by 10 billion. He criticised tax exemptions on large wealth.
why: Tax policy on wealth and consumption determines government revenue and fiscal space in Greece, which matters for sovereign bond investors.
